item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 03/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring fine and very hot weather to southern China tomorrow. The northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong on Wednesday. It will be windy with a few showers and temperatures will fall slightly over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. Another dry northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early next week.
